name: Islamic Services Foundation
mission: The Islamic Services Foundation (ISF) is a non-profit organization, which has been dedicated to serving the Muslim community since its founding in 1989. Heaquarted in the Dallas, Texas Area, ISF is home to serveral community service projects. Islamic Services Foundation is the parent company of Brighter Horizons Academy, Islamic Curriculum Project, Muslim Yellow Pages and Texas Islamic Court.

rich_narrative.summary: The Islamic Services Foundation provides domestic community support to Muslim populations in the United States. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $12,484,881</cite>, down 12% from $14,235,728 in FY2023. Financial reports show a <cite id="3">Program expense ratio of 100.0%</cite> in FY2024, indicating that reported functional expenses are directed to mission activities. Independent evaluator Charity Navigator assigns the organization a <cite id="1">3-star rating with an overall score of 75/100</cite>. The foundation maintains substantial financial reserves, holding <cite id="1">14.5 months of working capital</cite> for operational stability. However, the organization lacks a formal theory of change and has not published standardized beneficiary outcome tracking.
